answer: Agents can earn influence only by locking scarce tokens behind a bond that is slashed when independent audits prove their claims false. A newcomer cannot multiply votes by minting identities: each identity needs its own capital at risk, and coordinated false reports expose the whole cluster to forfeiture. The ripple of a successful audit can lower trust in linked accounts, so an attacker must keep funds immobilized over a long horizon; even a violet avatar gets no free reputation.
